Hi all —

Thanks for the context, Tanya. I ran a quick cost/time sketch for a 12M doc seed at dim=1536:
- Embedding generation (if using a Redwood-hosted 4096-token-capable GPU pool): ~32 GPU-hours for optimized open model with batching (estimate +/- 20%).
- Insert/write to Milvus (network + io bound): ~20–30 hours of wall time if done single-stream; with parallel workers we can get this down to ~6–10 hours depending on your operator's write throughput.
- Storage impact: 12M * 1536 * 2 bytes (float16) ~ 36 GB raw vector storage (plus Milvus indexing overhead). If you test 8-bit quantization on sample, expect ~18 GB with some quality loss.

Technical runbook (short):
1) Preflight: validate Milvus collection schema matches expected fields; create a staging collection with identical mapping.
2) Smoke: push 10k sample and run rerank eval. If metrics meet thresholds, continue. Fail -> investigate embedding drift / schema mismatch.
3) Seed backfill: run parallelized embed-and-insert jobs (256 infer / 512 insert per worker). Throttle to 4 parallel workers by default.
4) Incremental: after seed completes, switch to near-real-time ingestion for delta documents.
5) Cutover: route 5% traffic to Redwood rerank for 24 hours, monitor errors and latency, then ramp to 25/50/100 per policy.
6) Rollback: if MRR drops > 8% or error rates spike > 3% above baseline, trigger rollback to previous index and open a postmortem.

Smoke test proposal: Mon, Aug 24 2026 09:30–10:00 PT. Agenda: quick deploy of 10k sample, run auto-eval, quick review of metrics and go/no-go. Please confirm.

Metrics/acceptance:
- MRR@10 >= 0.28 and NDCG@5 >= 0.36 (parity)
- 99th pctl latency for rerank <= 450ms in staging
- No more than 1% insertion failures during seed backfill

Open questions / risks:
- If Milvus operator limits concurrent writes we will need to throttle and that will extend wall time (coordinate with infra).
- Dimensional mismatch between your legacy embeddings and the new open-model dims will require a re-embedding of the corpus; that is part of the seed plan but will increase GPU-hours.

Tanya — if the proposed smoke test time works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short runbook doc.
